title: Human insulin
subtitle: Two protein chains, folded into one molecular signal
description: A protein is built from chains of small chemical units called amino acids. This insulin molecule has two chains: 21 units in chain A and 30 in chain B. Switch between a guide to the folded chains and the individual atoms and their chemical connections.
explanation: A protein is built from chains of small chemical units called amino acids. This insulin molecule has two chains: 21 units in chain A and 30 in chain B. Switch between a guide to the folded chains and the individual atoms and their chemical connections.

A sequence is more than a list. Its atoms fold into a three-dimensional arrangement. Three sulfur-to-sulfur bonds help hold insulin together: one within chain A and two joining A to B. Rotate the model to see how distant parts of the sequence meet in space.

These coordinates come from an X-ray crystal structure, not a movie inside a person. We show one A/B insulin molecule from a larger zinc-containing assembly. It teaches how sequence and shape connect; it does not establish an ovarian-cancer target or predict a treatment response.
limits: One A/B insulin molecule selected from a crystal hexamer; water, ions, other chains and crystal neighbours are omitted. Six unresolved side-chain atoms and hydrogens are absent. A static reference structure is not a simulation of a living cell or evidence of treatment benefit.

metadata.claimStatus: VERIFIED reference-coordinate derivation; not a Project Asma experimental result

citation.title: Crystallographic evidence for dual coordination around zinc in the T3R3 human insulin hexamer.

metadata.organism: Homo sapiens sequence; crystalline biosynthetic human insulin
metadata.mutationNote: Entry is engineered/synthetic; RCSB polymer-entity metadata reports zero mutations. This does not mean it is an unmodified biological sample.
metadata.omissions: All HETATM records (including water, zinc, chloride and sodium), author chains C/D, and crystallographic symmetry copies. The deposit lacks LYS B29 CG/CD/CE/NZ and THR B30 OG1/CG2 side-chain atoms; these and hydrogens are not added.

alternateLocations.policy: Highest occupancy for each atom; ties prefer blank then A; preserve file order thereafter.

metadata.coordinates: Deposited Cartesian coordinates retained without reflection, smoothing, relaxation or rescaling. Units are angstroms (1 Å = 0.1 nm).
metadata.stereochemistry: Inherited from deposited coordinates and residue identity; no stereocentres, missing atoms, hydrogens or protonation states are generated.
metadata.bonds: Within-residue connectivity and order from deposited _chem_comp_bond; sequential polymer C–N or O3′–P links added by known chain order and checked for plausible length. Disulfides and hydrogen contacts come from deposited _struct_conn. No distance-only bond inference.
metadata.bondDrawing: A single stick indicates connectivity; displayed stick count need not encode deposited bond order. Atom spheres are illustrative, not measured surfaces.
metadata.backbone: Guide links between successive CA atoms in each chain. These are not direct chemical bonds or measured surfaces.
metadata.contacts: Deposited donor/acceptor heavy-atom pairs for Watson–Crick hydrogen bonds; not hydrogen-atom coordinates and not covalent interstrand bonds.
